detail.longDescription:
Lots of updates and fixes in FeedEcho v1.48.0 → v1.52.0

Queue system hardening:

- Double-post prevention
- Failure visibility
- Atomic cancel (status-guarded transaction)

Images end-to-end (v1.49.0, v1.50.0, v1.52.0)

- Mastodon: 4 images per post (was 1)
- Email: the attach_image toggle actually works now
- Bluesky: blob cap 1 MB → 2 MB (matching Bluesky's April 2026 limit) and oversized images downscaled/re-encoded via new images.py
- Alt text: pasted full /chat/completions endpoints normalized; Test Vision API button reports real failures instead of a false green

Infra resilience

- Automatic egress fallback proxy (Cloudflare Worker) for feed/image fetches on 403/429
- utils.py (stdlib-only shared helpers), unified email validation rules

Internal refactors, audit-driven (v1.49.1, v1.50.1, v1.51.0)

- Duplication audit (29 findings): destination dispatchers share one skeleton — which surfaced and fixed two real drift bugs (deleted accounts burning retries instead of gave_up)
- Design-patterns audit: _DESTINATION_HANDLERS registry, shared DestinationError hierarchy, login mode split, saved-search cache class

Error handling & UX (v1.51.1, v1.51.2)

- Branded 500/403/CSRF error pages instead of blank or plain-text responses; alt-text retry hygiene; logging consistency
- Mobile nav discoverability (edge-fade wrapper), Echoes empty-state guidance, assorted form/select styling
